description.value: Pan Pacific Whistler Village Centre is a luxury full-service hotel situated at the heart of Whistler Village on Blackcomb Way, part of the international Pan Pacific Hotels Group chain. Its village-centre location places guests steps from Whistler's extensive trail network and the Valley Trail multi-use path. The property is undergoing elevator maintenance through mid-2026 but remains fully operational.
